history.title: ART formed
history.text: ART was created through the merger of Sunsuper and QSuper. High Growth's published long-term history uses predecessor Sunsuper Growth returns before the merger.

history.title: Growth renamed High Growth
history.text: ART states the option was renamed from Growth to High Growth and its asset allocation and allowable ranges were updated.

history.title: Strategic allocation updated
history.text: Australian shares 32.25%, international shares 33.25%, unlisted/alternatives 31.5%, fixed income 1%, cash 2%.

history.title: Strategic allocation updated again
history.text: Australian shares fell to 31.25%, international shares rose to 34%, unlisted/alternatives to 32%, fixed income to 1.75% and cash fell to 1%. Overall issuer-reported growth exposure remained around 85%.

history.title: Current strategic target effective
history.text: Aware's current published Future Saver target is 88% growth / 12% defensive with 28.5% Australian shares and 38.5% international shares.

history.title: Latest actual allocation published
history.text: Actual allocation was close to target: 28.4% Australian shares, 38.7% international shares, 6.9% private equity, 10.3% infrastructure, 6.8% property and 5.5% cash, among other assets.
